headline: I worry about not trying
dek: The President posts words of Senator John Kennedy on Fox News: some people worry about losing, he worries about not trying. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: “Some people worry about losing, I worry about not trying. I can explain a loss, I can’t explain to my people why I didn’t try!”
Highly Respected Senator John Kennedy, of Louisiana, being interviewed by Kayleigh McEnany on FoxNews
original.key: “Some people worry about losing, I worry about not trying. I can explain a loss, I can’t explain to my people why I didn’t try!”
original.context: Posted on 14 November 2026. The President posts, in quotation marks, words of Senator John Kennedy of Louisiana in an interview on Fox News.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 14 November 2026 (shown as 11/14/26, 9:40 AM Pacific).

en: About nine popular initiatives in ten are rejected at the ballot box. Swiss citizens keep launching new ones anyway.
We can explain a loss. Usually in four languages.
